title: Ways to travel
examples: What do we use to go to the park?
Can planes travel in the water?
What is the biggest way to travel?

explain.say: We can travel in many different ways.

draw.text: Ways to travel: land, sea, air

explain.say: Land travel uses roads and tracks to move us.
Sea travel uses big boats to cross the water.
Air travel uses planes to fly high in the sky.
A car travels on land, a boat travels on sea, and a plane travels in air.
If you want to visit a friend on another island, you might take a boat across the sea.

faq.a: No, boats need water to move across. They are designed for the sea or rivers.
asks: Do boats need water to float?

faq.q: Are planes always in the air?
faq.a: Yes, planes fly high up in the air. They need enough space to fly safely.

faq.q: What is the difference between land and sea travel?
faq.a: Land travel uses roads and tracks on the ground. Sea travel uses boats on water.
asks: What do cars use to move?
What do boats need to move?

faq.q: Can we use a car to cross a big ocean?
faq.a: No, cars need roads. You need a boat or a ferry to cross a big ocean.
asks: Can I drive across the sea?

faq.q: What is the fastest way to travel?
faq.a: This depends on where you are going. Planes are very fast for long distances in the air.

facts: Cars travel on land using roads.
Boats travel on sea or rivers using water.
Planes travel through the air using wings.
Ferry boats carry cars and people across water.

quiz.say: To go from one country to another across the ocean, you would most likely use a:
quiz.why: Boats are designed to travel across large bodies of water like oceans.

wrong.0: A train stays on tracks and cannot cross open water.
wrong.2: A car needs roads and cannot float on the open sea.
wrong.3: A plane needs air to fly and cannot travel on water.

quiz.say: Which mode of transport moves through the air?
quiz.why: Planes have wings and are built specifically to fly in the air.

wrong.0: A car moves on the ground or land.
wrong.1: While balloons are in the air, planes are built for faster, controlled travel.
wrong.3: A boat moves on the water, not through the air.

quiz.say: If you are traveling across a river, which type of transport is best?
quiz.why: A boat is meant to float and travel across water like a river.

wrong.0: A bike needs a solid path or road to ride on.
wrong.2: A car will get stuck or sink in the river water.
wrong.3: A plane needs open air, not a river surface.
